flat ring maps are stable under composition (Algebra, Lemma algebra-lemma-composition-flat)
core_obligations: Prove that the property rig-flat on arrows of WAdm^Noeth is stable under composition: if A -> B and B -> C are rig-flat, then A -> C is rig-flat
proof_roadmap: The composite A -> C is adic and topologically of finite type by the composition lemma.
For each f in A the localizations A_{f} -> B_{f} -> C_{f} are naively rig-flat because the original maps are rig-flat.
Naive rig-flatness is flatness of the local maps, and flatness is stable under composition, so A_{f} -> C_{f} is naively rig-flat for all f, which is rig-flatness of A -> C.
difficulty_reason: H2: a composition lemma reduced to the composition of flat local maps.
